description: The hand-rolled parse (INI-3, B-14): keys and values untrimmed, keys lowercased, values not, lines before any header under NO-SECTION, lines without '=' skipped, a value keeping later '='s, an empty header, a header that doesn't end with ']', a header with no keys, and splitlines() breaking on \v, \x1c and U+2028. Port: fixed, see deviation #17.

deviations.reason: The port reads game INIs with a UTF-8 BOM stripped, falls back to Windows-1252 for non-UTF-8 bytes, and trims lines, keys and values.
